dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ....Did it really go this way? I don't see it anywhere. Ugh, I'm so tired, I can barely take another step...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: But if I don't find it, Boss Nef's gonna be real miffed... Argh! Stupid, stupid cat!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoa! D—Don't sneak up on me like that!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *sigh* Good thing you're here, though. I don't suppose you've seen a black-and-white-striped cat around here?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Uhm... It's got a huge tail and a blue bow around its neck.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Yeah! I dunno why, though — Boss Nef suddenly got it in her head to send me out here on this gig. Said I needed to "pay close attention to my surroundings"...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I told her if she wanted to find a cat, she could just put up a commission at the guild. They're always running around helping people find stuff...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: But she insisted I go looking myself! I've been wandering around here all day without spotting so much as a strand of fur...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: If I go back empty-handed, Boss Nef's probably gonna scold me...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Ugh, what am I doing yammering away? I need to get back to searching for that blasted cat.

choices.text: So you're looking for said cat here?
